name: Rice (Paddy)
ideal_soil: Clayey loam or alluvial soils capable of holding standing water
climate: Warm and humid tropical/sub-tropical climate
sowing_window: May-June for nursery, June-July transplanting
seed_rate_per_acre: 12-15 kg for transplanting; 6-8 kg for DSR; 2-2.5 kg for SRI
spacing_cm: 20 cm x 15 cm (Transplanting) or 25 cm x 25 cm (SRI)
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 85-90 kg (in 3 splits), DAP: 40 kg, MOP: 25 kg, Zinc Sulphate (21%): 10 kg
irrigation_stages: Maintain 2-5 cm standing water till flowering, then practice Alternate Wetting & Drying (AWD); drain water 10 days before harvest
harvesting_indicators: 80-85% of the panicles turn golden yellow and grain moisture drops to 20-22%

name: Wheat
ideal_soil: Well-drained fertile clay-loam or loam soils
climate: Cool winter growing season and dry sunny warm ripening period
sowing_window: November 1 to November 25 (timely sown)
seed_rate_per_acre: 40 kg (timely sown); 50 kg (late sown after Nov 25)
spacing_cm: 20-22.5 cm row to row, 5 cm plant to plant (using zero-till seed drill)
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 110 kg (half at sowing, 2 splits at 1st and 2nd irrigation), DAP: 55 kg, MOP: 20 kg
irrigation_stages: Crown Root Initiation (CRI at 21 days - Critical!), Tillering (40-45 d), Jointing (60-65 d), Flowering (80-85 d), Milking (100-105 d), Dough (115-120 d)
harvesting_indicators: Straw and spikes turn golden yellow, grains become hard and break with teeth (moisture < 12-14%)

name: Maize (Corn)
ideal_soil: Deep, well-drained fertile sandy loam to clay loam rich in organic matter
climate: Warm weather crop; susceptible to frost and waterlogging
sowing_window: Kharif: June-July; Rabi: October-November; Spring: February
seed_rate_per_acre: 8 kg for hybrid grain; 16 kg for fodder
spacing_cm: 60 cm row-to-row x 20 cm plant-to-plant
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 90 kg (3 splits: sowing, knee-high, tasseling), DAP: 50 kg, MOP: 30 kg, Zinc: 10 kg
irrigation_stages: Knee-high stage, Tasseling stage (most critical!), Silking and early grain filling stage
harvesting_indicators: Cob sheath turns paper white and dried; black layer appears at grain tip (physiological maturity)

name: Pearl Millet (Bajra)
ideal_soil: Light sandy to sandy loam, even shallow soils
climate: Extremely drought-hardy, thrives in hot arid climates
sowing_window: June 15 to July 15
spacing_cm: 45 cm x 15 cm
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 40 kg, DAP: 35 kg, MOP: 15 kg (apply half N at sowing, half at 30 days)
irrigation_stages: Mostly rainfed; if dry, irrigate at tillering and flowering
harvesting_indicators: Grains become hard and dry; moisture drops below 15-18%

name: Sorghum (Jowar)
ideal_soil: Medium to deep black soils with good moisture retention
climate: Warm and semi-arid dry climates
sowing_window: Kharif: June-July; Rabi: September 15 - October 15
spacing_cm: 45 cm x 15 cm
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 50 kg, DAP: 40 kg, MOP: 15 kg
irrigation_stages: Rainfed in Kharif; Rabi needs 1-2 irrigations at flag leaf and boot stage if rain fails
harvesting_indicators: Black layer forms on seed connection; panicle turns dry golden

name: Finger Millet (Ragi)
ideal_soil: Red sandy loam, laterite, gravelly soils
climate: Tropical and subtropical, high calcium super-cereal
sowing_window: June - July (transplanting in July-August)
spacing_cm: 22.5 cm x 10 cm
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 35 kg, DAP: 30 kg, MOP: 15 kg
irrigation_stages: Rainfed; requires drainage during heavy downpours
harvesting_indicators: Ear heads turn brownish-grey, seeds turn dark brown

name: Chickpea (Gram / Chana)
ideal_soil: Well-drained medium to heavy black cotton soils or alluvial loam
climate: Cool and dry climate; sensitive to frost and cloudiness during flowering
sowing_window: October 15 to November 15
spacing_cm: 30 cm x 10 cm
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: DAP: 40 kg, MOP: 15 kg, Gypsum: 40 kg, Rhizobium bio-fertilizer seed inoculation
irrigation_stages: Pre-sowing (Palewa), Pre-flowering stage (45 days), Pod development stage (75 days). Avoid irrigation during active flowering!
harvesting_indicators: Leaves turn yellowish brown, drop down; pods become crisp paper-dry with rattling seeds inside

name: Pigeon Pea (Tur / Arhar)
ideal_soil: Deep, well-drained loam to clay loam; intolerant to water stagnation
climate: Warm tropical and sub-tropical climate
sowing_window: June 15 to July 15 (with onset of monsoon)
spacing_cm: 90-120 cm row-to-row x 20-30 cm plant-to-plant
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 10 kg, DAP: 40 kg, MOP: 15 kg, Sulphur (Elemental): 8 kg
irrigation_stages: Branching (30-35 d), Flowering (60-70 d), Pod fill (90-100 d)
harvesting_indicators: 80% of the pods turn brown and dry; rattle upon shaking

name: Green Gram (Moong)
ideal_soil: Well-drained sandy loam to clay loam soils
climate: Warm and humid season; short 60-75 day duration
sowing_window: Kharif: June-July; Summer: March 15 - April 10
spacing_cm: 30 cm x 10 cm
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: DAP: 35 kg, MOP: 10 kg, Rhizobium + PSB seed coating
irrigation_stages: Summer needs 3-4 irrigations: at 20 days, flowering, and pod formation
top_pests_diseases: Yellow Mosaic Virus (YMV transmitted by Whitefly)
harvesting_indicators: Pods turn blackish brown and dry; 2-3 hand pickings or single harvest when 85% mature

name: Black Gram (Urad)
ideal_soil: Loam to heavy clay soils with good moisture retention
climate: Warm and humid tropical climate
sowing_window: Kharif: June-July; Rabi rice-fallow: November; Summer: March
spacing_cm: 30 cm x 10 cm
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: DAP: 35 kg, MOP: 10 kg, Sulphur: 5 kg
irrigation_stages: Usually rainfed in Kharif; 2 irrigations in summer at branching and pod fill
harvesting_indicators: Pods turn black and mature; harvest whole plants in early morning to prevent shattering

name: Mustard & Rapeseed (Sarson / Raya)
ideal_soil: Sandy loam to clay loam; tolerant of light alkalinity
climate: Cool and bright sunshine weather; susceptible to frost and aphid epidemics during cloudiness
sowing_window: October 1 to October 25 (critical to evade aphids!)
spacing_cm: 45 cm x 10-15 cm (thinning at 15-20 days is mandatory)
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 50 kg (half at sowing, half at 1st irrigation), SSP (Single Super Phosphate): 100 kg, MOP: 15 kg, Sulphur: 10 kg (crucial for oil %)
irrigation_stages: Rosette stage (25-30 days), Siliquae formation stage (50-60 days)
harvesting_indicators: 75% of siliquae (pods) turn lemon-yellow; seed moisture below 10-12%

name: Groundnut (Peanut / Moongphali)
ideal_soil: Well-drained light sandy loam, red sandy loam or loose friable soils (essential for peg penetration!)
climate: Warm and tropical, needs sunshine during pod development
sowing_window: Kharif: June-July; Rabi/Summer: November-December or Jan-Feb
spacing_cm: 30 cm x 10 cm
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 15 kg, DAP: 35 kg, MOP: 25 kg, Gypsum: 160-200 kg (in 2 splits at sowing and pegging at 40 days for shell calcification!)
irrigation_stages: Pegging stage (35-40 d - DO NOT DISTURB SOIL), Pod formation (50-65 d), Pod filling (75-80 d)
harvesting_indicators: Inner shell wall becomes dark brown / blackish, veins pronounced, leaves turn yellow and drop

name: Soybean
ideal_soil: Well-drained deep black soils (vertisols) or clay loam; sensitive to waterlogging
climate: Warm and moist climate
sowing_window: June 15 to July 10 (after 100mm monsoon rain)
spacing_cm: 45 cm x 5-7 cm (plant using Broad Bed and Furrow - BBF)
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: DAP: 40 kg, MOP: 15 kg, Sulphur (Bentonite): 10 kg, Rhizobium japonicum + PSB seed dressing
irrigation_stages: Rainfed; supplementary irrigation at pod filling stage if dry spell occurs
harvesting_indicators: Pods turn yellow-brown, leaves shed completely, seed moisture drops to 14-15%

name: Cotton (Bt Cotton / Kapas)
ideal_soil: Deep Black Cotton Soil (Regur) with high water retention capacity
climate: Tropical and subtropical, warm days and cool nights during boll development; frost-free period > 200 days
sowing_window: North (Punjab/Haryana): April 15 - May 15; Central/South: June 15 - July 15
seed_rate_per_acre: 1.5 - 2 packets (900 grams) of Bt Cotton hybrid
spacing_cm: 90 cm x 60 cm (or 120 cm x 45 cm for drip)
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 80 kg (split: 30, 60, 90 days), DAP: 45 kg, MOP: 35 kg, Magnesium Sulphate: 10 kg, Boron spray at squaring
irrigation_stages: Square formation (45 d), Flowering (65 d), Boll development (85-110 d). Avoid excess moisture during opening!
harvesting_indicators: Bolls burst open fully revealing white fluffy lint; pick in morning after dew dries

name: Sugarcane (Ganna)
season: Annual / 10-14 months (Autumn: Oct-Nov, Spring: Feb-March, Adsali: July-Aug)
ideal_soil: Deep fertile well-drained loams, clay loams, or alluvial soils rich in organic matter
climate: Warm and humid tropical/subtropical climate, requires dry sunny season during ripening
sowing_window: Autumn planting: Oct-Nov; Spring planting: Feb-March
harvesting_window: November to April (10 to 12 months after planting)
spacing_cm: 120-150 cm row-to-row (wide row for trench/drip)
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 175 kg (in 4 splits), DAP: 75 kg, MOP: 60 kg, Zinc: 10 kg, Iron sulphate spray for chlorosis
irrigation_stages: Germination (every 7-10 days), Tillering (every 10-12 days), Grand growth (every 10 days), Maturation (interval 15-20 days; withhold 15 days before harvest)
harvesting_indicators: Brix reading > 18-20% by hand refractometer; bottom nodes ring hollow when tapped; leaves dry and turn yellow

name: Tomato
ideal_soil: Well-drained rich sandy loam to clay loam soils with high organic matter
climate: Warm sunny days (20-25°C) and cool nights (15-18°C) are ideal for lycopene color formation
sowing_window: Kharif: May-June; Rabi: September-October; Summer: December-January
harvesting_window: Begins 65-75 days after transplanting; lasts 8-12 pickings
seed_rate_per_acre: 40 - 50 grams for F1 Hybrids; 100 grams for open pollinated
spacing_cm: 90 cm x 60 cm (staked) or 60 cm x 45 cm
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 60 kg, DAP: 50 kg, MOP: 40 kg, Micronutrient spray (Boron + Calcium) to prevent Blossom End Rot
irrigation_stages: Immediate post transplanting, then every 4-6 days via drip irrigation
top_pests_diseases: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV transmitted by Whitefly)
harvesting_indicators: Picked at Breaker/Turning stage for long distance transport; picked at Firm Red Ripe stage for local processing

name: Potato (Aloo)
ideal_soil: Loose, friable, well-drained sandy loam rich in organic matter
climate: Cool weather crop; tuberization requires night temperatures of 15 - 20°C
sowing_window: North Plains: October 15 - November 5; Hills: March-April
seed_rate_per_acre: 8 - 12 Quintals of healthy seed tubers (30-40 g size with 2-3 eyes)
spacing_cm: 60 cm row-to-row x 20 cm plant-to-plant (on ridges)
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 80 kg (split: half basal, half at earthing up), DAP: 75 kg, MOP: 50 kg
irrigation_stages: Every 7-10 days; 5-6 irrigations total; avoid submerging ridges; stop 10 days before dehaulming
harvesting_indicators: Cut haulms (foliage) 10-12 days before digging to cure tuber skin; skin does not peel when rubbed with thumb

name: Onion (Piyaz)
ideal_soil: Deep friable loam to sandy loam with good organic matter and high drainage
climate: Mild climate without extreme heat or cold
sowing_window: Rabi nursery: Oct-Nov, transplanting Dec-Jan; Kharif nursery: May-June, transplanting July-Aug
harvesting_window: Rabi: April-May (Best storage quality); Kharif: Oct-Nov
spacing_cm: 15 cm x 10 cm on flat or raised beds
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 65 kg (in 3 splits), DAP: 45 kg, MOP: 35 kg, Sulphur (Bentonite): 15 kg (enhances pungency and storage life)
irrigation_stages: Frequent light irrigations every 5-7 days; stop irrigation 12-15 days before harvesting
harvesting_indicators: 50% of tops fall over (neck fall); neck becomes thin and outer scales dry

name: Chilli & Capsicum (Mirch)
ideal_soil: Well-drained light loamy to black soils rich in organic matter
climate: Warm and humid tropical climate; dry weather required for fruit ripening
sowing_window: Kharif: May-June; Rabi: September-October; Summer: January
harvesting_window: Green chilli: 60-70 days after planting; Dry red chilli: 90-110 days
seed_rate_per_acre: 80 - 100 grams for hybrid seeds; 200 grams for regular varieties
spacing_cm: 60 cm x 45 cm or 75 cm x 45 cm
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 60 kg, DAP: 50 kg, MOP: 35 kg, Zinc and Boron foliar sprays
irrigation_stages: Sensitive to waterlogging and drought; drip irrigation every 3-4 days
average_yield_per_acre: Green chilli: 40 - 60 Quintals; Dry red chilli: 10 - 15 Quintals
harvesting_indicators: Picked green for market; picked deep red and sun-dried to 10% moisture for dry chilli

name: Mango (Aam - King of Fruits)
ideal_soil: Deep, well-drained alluvial or red loamy soil with depth > 2 meters
climate: Tropical and subtropical; frost-free with dry weather during flowering (Jan-Feb)
sowing_window: Planting of grafts: July to September (monsoon)
seed_rate_per_acre: 40 grafts per acre (10m x 10m conventional); 200-400 grafts (High Density 5m x 5m)
spacing_cm: 10 m x 10 m (traditional) or 5 m x 3 m (Ultra High Density UHD)
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Adult tree: 1000g N, 500g P, 1000g K per tree per year in post-monsoon; Paclobutrazol (Cultar) for regular bearing
irrigation_stages: Irrigate during fruit set and development (Feb-April); strictly withhold water 2-3 months prior to flowering!
harvesting_indicators: Fruit tapers/shoulders fill out; color changes from dark green to olive; latex does not spurt upon stem detachment

name: Banana (Kela)
ideal_soil: Rich, deep, well-drained clay loam to sandy loam with 1.5% organic matter
climate: Warm, humid tropical climate with protection from high winds
sowing_window: May-June or September-October (tissue culture plantlets)
spacing_cm: 1.8 m x 1.8 m or paired row (1.5m x 1.5m x 2m)
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Fertigation per plant: 200g Urea, 60g DAP, 300g MOP in weekly splits through drip
irrigation_stages: Continuous moisture required; 15-20 liters water/plant/day through drip system
harvesting_indicators: Fruit angles disappear, becoming rounded; floral remnants drop; harvest at 75-80% maturity for transport

name: Apple (Seb)
ideal_soil: Deep, well-drained fertile loam rich in organic matter, depth > 1.5 m
climate: Cold temperate mountain climate; requires 800 - 1200 chilling hours (< 7°C)
sowing_window: Planting of dormant bare-root grafts: December to February
seed_rate_per_acre: 150-200 trees (seedling rootstock) or 800-1200 trees (High Density M9 dwarfing rootstock)
spacing_cm: 6m x 6m (traditional) or 3m x 1m (High Density trellis)
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Adult tree: 700g N, 350g P, 700g K + FYM 40kg per tree in winter
irrigation_stages: Crucial at fruit set, rapid cell division (May-June), and fruit swelling
harvesting_indicators: Background green turns yellow, characteristic red stripe/blush develops, starch-iodine index test

name: Turmeric (Haldi)
ideal_soil: Deep, loose, fertile well-drained sandy loam or red loam rich in humus
climate: Warm and humid tropical climate; benefits from light partial shade
sowing_window: May to June (pre-monsoon planting of mother or finger rhizomes)
harvesting_window: January to March (when leaves turn yellow and dry)
seed_rate_per_acre: 8 - 10 Quintals of mother or finger rhizomes
spacing_cm: 45 cm x 20 cm on raised beds (ridge-and-furrow)
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Urea: 50 kg (in 3 splits), DAP: 40 kg, MOP: 45 kg, FYM: 10 tonnes
irrigation_stages: Irrigate every 7-10 days; mulch beds with green leaves (5 tonnes/acre) at planting
average_yield_per_acre: 80 - 100 Quintals fresh rhizomes (16 - 20 Quintals cured dry turmeric)
harvesting_indicators: Foliage turns completely yellow, dries, and wilts down to ground

name: Tea (Chai)
ideal_soil: Well-drained deep, friable acidic loam rich in organic matter
climate: Warm and moist subtropical/tropical climate with high humidity and mist
sowing_window: Transplanting of clonal nursery cuttings: April-June or Sept-Oct
harvesting_window: Plucking: First Flush (March-April), Second Flush (May-June), Autumn Flush (Oct-Nov)
seed_rate_per_acre: 5,000 to 6,000 clonal bush plants per acre
spacing_cm: 105 cm x 75 cm or staggered double-hedge (105 x 75 x 75 cm)
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Annual bush maintenance: 50 kg N, 15 kg P, 50 kg K, 10 kg Zinc Sulphate foliar spray
irrigation_stages: Sprinkler irrigation during dry winter-spring months (Jan-April)
harvesting_indicators: Fine plucking standard: 'Two leaves and a bud' plucked at 7-10 day intervals

name: Coffee (Arabica & Robusta)
ideal_soil: Deep, friable, porous rich forest loams with abundant humus and high drainage
climate: Shade-grown tropical highland climate (Arabica: 1000-1500m; Robusta: 500-1000m)
rainfall_requirement_mm: 1500 - 2000 mm with crucial Blossom Showers in March-April
sowing_window: Planting in field during onset of monsoon (June - July)
spacing_cm: Arabica: 2m x 2m; Robusta: 3m x 3m (grown under two-tier shade trees: Silver Oak, Dadap)
fertilizer_npk_kg_per_acre: Per acre: 40 kg N, 30 kg P, 40 kg K in pre-monsoon and post-monsoon splits
irrigation_stages: Blossom showers (March) and Backing showers (April) via sprinkler if dry
harvesting_indicators: Berries turn bright crimson red; picked manually (fly picking, main picking, strippings)
